dogecoin.text: I'm just going to say that $SHIB could be the best thing to happen to $DOGE. I think @elonmusk knows this. With #SHIB becoming the new hot coin that people are taking to the moon, doge will level out and actually become a stable coin and a viable for currency replacement.

If you missed the $DOGE train it's because you didn't know better.  If you miss the $SHIB train what's your excuse? At this point even $10 of #SHIB could make you money. The longer you wait the less impact that $10 will have

I've never personally owned any #Dogecoin but I think one day we're going to look back just how important it was to cryptocurrency. Whether you love it or hate it you can't deny that it was many people's first foray into crypto. It brought in a lot of new people and new money

Doge is great if you got in years ago. If you bought $1000 of $Doge at .30 and IF Doge gets to $1 you'd have $3333. $1000 of shib at .0000085 will make you $4588 and all we have to do is match our all time time of .000039. MUCH higher ceiling with $shib.
